latestMilestone: PR #17 is merged into the canonical SWIR_OS main at eeaef96bca854fe3e4ca54f7c8f88a880774976e. System Edition now includes a native GTK4 SWIR Hardware & Driver Center foundation backed by the existing read-only Driver Center report. The image stages the trusted report runtime, hardware catalog and trusted-source policy; report parsing fails closed unless diagnostics remain read-only, non-auto-mutating and free of policy violations. The UI exposes no install/apply/module-load/firmware-flash controls and introduces no arbitrary driver-download path; the existing journaled Driver Center mutation coordinator remains the privileged apply boundary. The exact final PR head passed all eight triggered workflows, including native Hardware Center, graphical session, Live USB install and full graphical installer UEFI E2E. Roadmap remains 51/65 (78.5%) because this foundation does not complete the full dependable daily-use native application suite or release readiness. Physical Live USB qualification remains pending; Secure Boot and legacy BIOS are not claimed.
